recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless future publisher changes stop emitting Base for these workflow pattern logical models.
issue_request: FHIR-25199 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested that the Definition, Request, and Event workflow pattern logical models avoid inheriting Element.id and Element.extension by declaring Base, not Element, as their baseDefinition.
initial_application: No source-changing commit tagged FHIR-25199 was found. The issue appears to have been applied through the R5 logical-model/type-system work: Base was added as an active abstract infrastructure type, the workflow patterns remained active logical spreadsheet artifacts, and the R5 published XML for Definition, Request, and Event declares baseDefinition as http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Base.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread records the Base-without-id/extension rationale and Grahame's later statement that pattern logical models should extend Base. FHIR-25031 introduced Base, FHIR-39803/FHIR-39806 updated StructureDefinition.baseDefinition guidance to mention Base, and FHIR-27839 handled broader interface inheritance; those related issues are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because current source registers Base and the workflow logical artifacts, the StructureDefinition/logical-model guidance permits Base, and both R5 and CI generated XML for Definition, Request, and Event already use Base.

related_jiras.note: Introduced and documented the no-properties Base type that makes the FHIR-25199 resolution possible.

Updated StructureDefinition.baseDefinition guidance for logical models to include Base; already audited on the combined branch.
Duplicate-family wording update for StructureDefinition.baseDefinition comments; already audited on the combined branch.
